rows.grounds: root śak, first person singular active present

items.question: Why can the speaker not tell that fruit to the Kula goddess?
premises: The speaker cannot tell that fruit.
The fruit is addressed to the Kula goddess.
items.inference: The fruit's greatness exceeds what can be spoken.
uncertainties: Whether tatphalam functions as a direct object or a compound adjective.
items.plain_english: O Kula goddess, I am not able to tell that fruit.
